articles.headline: Ronaldo off Al Nassr's ACL squad due to Saudi security concerns
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo is being rested for Al Nassr's AFC Champions League trip to Uzbekistan amid concern that the security situation in Saudi Arabia will continue to impact Asia's top soccer tournaments.

articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.
